scoringMatrices.name: Offer Dynamic Relevance & Slot Placement Matrix
scoringMatrices.description: Composite multi-objective scoring formula balancing traveler life-safety, commercial yield, contextual fit, and user friction.

dimensions.name: LifeSafetyRank
dimensions.description: Editorial assessment of real-world harm reduction and crisis mitigation efficacy.

dimensions.name: CommercialYieldScore
dimensions.description: Expected monetary yield: min(100, 1000 * 0.03 * ConversionRate * EffectiveCpa * 15).

dimensions.name: ContextualAffinity
dimensions.description: Relevance boost when offer category directly maps to the active lifecycle (e.g. eSIM at Night Arrival, Doorstop at Lodging Lockdown).

dimensions.name: FrictionInverseScore
dimensions.description: Ease of onboarding: 95 for instant zero-hardware digital services (eSIM, insurance), 60 for physical shipping.

scoringMatrices.name: Partner Underwriter Solvency & Trust Index
scoringMatrices.description: Evaluates financial health, claim payout speed, and regulatory standing of partner companies.

dimensions.name: underwriterSolvency
dimensions.description: AM Best rating (A++ = 100, A+ = 90, A = 80, Unrated = 40)

dimensions.name: claimTurnaroundDays
dimensions.description: Average speed to resolve medical and theft claims (<7 days = 100, <30 days = 70)

dimensions.name: regulatoryComplianceHistory
dimensions.description: Zero regulatory sanctions or consumer complaints in past 5 years
